games.title: Bloodborne
games.description: Hunt through Yharnam. An independent bbport/shadPS4-derived runtime executes game x86-64 code and translates graphics to Vulkan. This is not an official PC release.

requirements.cpu: Intel Core 4th gen+ / AMD Ryzen; AVX
requirements.memory: ~6 GB free RAM + pagefile; ~10 GB at 1440p/4K
requirements.notes: Pinned SuperMedo README, 2026-10-27; not PORT measurements.

compatibility.notes: User confirmed CUSA03173 1.09 launches and works. Performance depends on hardware.

requiredFiles: Own compatible base CUSA03173 PKG or prepared folder
Confirmed cumulative 01.09 PKG; base then update in two steps
